verdict.rationale: Financial Connections' own use-cases docs list a "Link CLI" for agent-driven financial insights (spending analysis, balance and transaction monitoring), and a probe confirms Stripe's official CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. However, the evidence is only a single table row and a probe hit, with no detail on which Financial Connections operations either CLI exposes. missing for 10: documentation of CLI commands covering Financial Connections (linking accounts, refreshing balances, ownership, transactions), install and auth details for the Link CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use via the CLI.
